svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Alarm 创建、去重、传播与异步通知

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Alarm 创建、去重、传播与异步通知
[active row does not exist and creation enabled]
[active row exists and fields are identical]
Alarm function and later entity_alarm saves do not share
one explicit service transaction in this creation path.
WebSocket, notification, Queue and audit are also outside it.
The Alarm is already persisted before alarmActionMsg enqueue.
Queue failure cannot roll it back.
[no create rule and clear rule matches]
On the successful path, original message success is independent
from the extra Alarm message producer callback.
The profile path does not call REST audit/EntityAction orchestration.
The partial active index is not UNIQUE.
Two active alarms may be inserted for the same originator and type.
